hypothesis: After execution, ENTER/WAIT timing, and HOLD/EXIT each improved but remained negative, the remaining bottleneck is either a low positive-opportunity ceiling in the current BUY-gated tradable population or poor economic ranking of otherwise available positive opportunities.

frozen_components.execution: Request244 one-second contract, 1s latency, 5s expiry, BASE primary

forced_state_value: For every causally admitted WATCH state, force ENTER at that state, then follow the frozen Request247 HOLD/EXIT policy and reconstruct one-second BASE return. Missing entry/exit remains unknown.

diagnostic_oracle.episode_best_return: maximum resolved forced-state BASE return among admitted states in the episode
diagnostic_oracle.episode_has_positive_opportunity: at least one resolved admitted forced-state return > 0
diagnostic_oracle.usage: diagnostic only; never a training target and never deployable

learnability_model.target: resolved forced-state BASE return at the current admitted state
learnability_model.features: causal Request243 source/path features plus causal tradability probability; no future fills, oracle max, future-best state, or Request246/247 outcomes
evaluation: Spearman correlation between predicted and realized forced-state return
ROC AUC and average precision for realized return > 0
top predicted quintile realized mean and positive rate

diagnostic_interpretation.candidate_population_bottleneck: positive-opportunity episode rate < 0.30 OR oracle episode-best mean <= 0
diagnostic_interpretation.representation_bottleneck: positive-opportunity episode rate >= 0.30 AND oracle episode-best mean > 0 BUT test ROC AUC < 0.60 AND Spearman < 0.10
diagnostic_interpretation.controller_composition_bottleneck: positive-opportunity ceiling healthy and ranking metrics materially positive, while frozen deployed controller remains negative
